cover_letter:
Dear Dalton team,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Lead / Growth Marketer role. What caught my attention is your belief that websites should optimize themselves—and that traditional A/B testing is broken. That's exactly the kind of shift I work on daily: I build and optimize websites for both traditional and AI-powered search, and I use AI tools and code to automate the repetitive work. I've seen how continuous optimization and personalization can drive measurable results, and I'd love to bring that mindset to Dalton.

I've built things myself. My own site, baverok.com, is a hand-coded WordPress/Elementor landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data, and a free site-check enquiry flow—I designed, built, and run it. For mirook.com, a site for a Belgian youth chess champion, I implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. These projects taught me to ship fast, measure, and iterate—an idea this week, live next week, numbers the week after.

At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I also manage CMS content in WordPress and Shopify, and I've run paid campaigns with Google Ads. I'm comfortable on camera and on stage, and I've coached others on content and SEO best practices. I'm based near Ghent, speak Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I'm excited about the prospect of working together in person.

Dalton's early-stage energy and the chance to build a marketing engine from scratch—video, conferences, webinars, paid media, brand messaging—is exactly the hands-on challenge I'm looking for. I'd love to help turn your momentum into a movement.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
